nodes.summary: Binomial probabilities vanish above `n`.
nodes.title: Binomial probabilities vanish above n

nodes.summary: For `a ≤ n` and `a / n ≤ p ≤ p' ≤ 1`, `Binom(a | n, p') ≤ Binom(a | n, p)`.
nodes.title: The binomial likelihood is unimodal in `p`, decreasing part

nodes.summary: For `a ≤ n` and `0 ≤ p ≤ p' ≤ a / n`, `Binom(a | n, p) ≤ Binom(a | n, p')`.
nodes.title: The binomial likelihood is unimodal in `p`, increasing part

nodes.summary: Binomial probabilities are nonnegative for `0 ≤ p ≤ 1`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of binomial probabilities

nodes.summary: Binomial probabilities are positive on `{0, …, n}` for `0 < p < 1`.
nodes.title: Positivity of binomial probabilities

nodes.summary: The binomial probability `C(n, i) p^i (1 - p)^(n - i)` of `i` successes in `n` trials, as a function of `i : ℕ`. It vanishes for `i > n` (the binomial coefficient is zero there, so the truncated subtraction `n - i` is harmless).
nodes.title: Binomial probability mass function

nodes.summary: The critical count is at most `n + 1` (for `FPR ≥ 0`).
nodes.title: Upper bound on the critical count

nodes.summary: The critical count is positive when `FPR < 1`.
nodes.title: Positivity of the critical count

nodes.summary: Carter's critical count `k = min {m | P(m) ≤ FPR}` for the null success probability `p₀ = ε / 3` (Online Methods, before Eq. 9).
nodes.title: Critical count of the mutation detection test

nodes.summary: Minimality of the critical count: `FPR < P(k - 1)` (for `0 ≤ FPR < 1`).
nodes.title: Minimality of the critical count

nodes.summary: The power is the mixture `(1 - d) P_f(X ≥ k) + d P_f(X ≥ k - 1)` of two tail probabilities.
nodes.title: Detection power as a mixture of tail probabilities

nodes.summary: `Pow(n, f) ≤ Pow(n, f')` for `0 ≤ f ≤ f' ≤ 1`.
nodes.title: Power increases with the allelic fraction

nodes.summary: Exact size (Carter et al. 2012, Eq. 9 with the randomization at `k - 1`): under the null `f = p₀` the rejection probability is exactly `FPR`, for `0 ≤ FPR < 1`.
nodes.title: Exact size

nodes.summary: Power decreases with local copy number at the ABSOLUTE allelic fraction, for a clonal mutation of multiplicity `0 ≤ s ≤ q ≤ q'` (Carter et al. 2012, Eqs. 2, 9, 10).
nodes.title: Power decreases with local copy number

nodes.summary: Power increases with multiplicity at the ABSOLUTE allelic fraction, for `0 ≤ s ≤ s' ≤ q` (Carter et al. 2012, Eqs. 2, 9).
nodes.title: Power increases with multiplicity

nodes.summary: Power increases with purity at the ABSOLUTE allelic fraction `α s / (α q + 2 (1 - α))` of a clonal mutation of multiplicity `0 ≤ s ≤ q` (Carter et al. 2012, Eqs. 2, 9, 10).
nodes.title: Power increases with purity

nodes.summary: The power `Pow(n, f) = P_f(X ≥ k) + d Binom(k - 1 | n, f)` of the exact-size randomized test (Carter et al. 2012, Eq. 9, with the randomization at `k - 1`; see the module doc).
nodes.title: Power of the randomized mutation detection test
The randomization is a probability

nodes.summary: The randomization probability `d = (FPR - P(k)) / (P(k - 1) - P(k))` of Eq. 9.
nodes.title: Randomization probability of the detection test

nodes.summary: The binomial law sums to one (the binomial theorem), for every real `p`.
nodes.title: Binomial probabilities sum to one

nodes.summary: `m ↦ P(m)` is antitone for `0 ≤ p ≤ 1`.
nodes.title: Binomial upper tail is decreasing

nodes.summary: The critical count meets the false-positive bound: `P(k) ≤ FPR` (for `FPR ≥ 0`).
nodes.title: Critical count meets the false-positive bound

nodes.summary: One step of the tail recursion: `P(m) = Binom(m | n, p) + P(m + 1)`.
nodes.title: Recursion for the binomial upper tail

nodes.summary: Carter's form of the tail: `P(m) = 1 - ∑_{i < m} Binom(i | n, p)`, for every `m`.
nodes.title: Binomial upper tail as one minus a lower sum

nodes.summary: `P(m) = 0` for `m > n`.
nodes.title: Binomial upper tail beyond n is zero
Binomial tails increase with the success probability

nodes.summary: Tail probabilities are nonnegative for `0 ≤ p ≤ 1`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of binomial tail probabilities

nodes.summary: The gap `P(k - 1) - P(k)` is the null probability of the boundary point `k - 1`.
nodes.title: Tail gap at the critical count

nodes.summary: `P(0) = 1`, for every real `p`.
nodes.title: Binomial upper tail from zero is one

nodes.summary: The binomial upper tail `ℙ_p(X ≥ m) = ∑_{m ≤ i ≤ n} C(n, i) p^i (1 - p)^(n - i)`, Carter's `P(m)` with `p = ε / 3`.
nodes.title: Binomial upper tail probability

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
